rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a suspended weight that swings back and forth.

example.english: This little experiment uses a pendulum to demonstrate gravity.
example.traditional: 呢個小實驗用擺錘嚟示範地心吸力。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 siu2 sat6 jim6 jung6 baai2 ceoi4 lai4 si6 faan6 dei6 sam1 kap1 lik6

rows.note: Use this specifically for the swinging part of a clock.

example.english: The pendulum in my old clock has stopped.
example.traditional: 我部老座鐘嘅鐘擺停咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bou6 lou5 zo6 zung1 ge3 zung1 baai2 ting4 zo2
